summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the PHP-native simbeng_v1 bengkel app. All 9 pytest backend tests pass (login, HSC search by name and by code auto-detect, short-query validation, import baru skip existing, import upgrade upsert, stock lookup autocomplete regression, stock/parts page load). Full UI walkthrough via Playwright also passes: hscField dropdown removed, HSC 'shock' search returns 25 live results from hargasukucadang.online, clicking a result auto-fills kode/nama and adds a new dynamic kategori option (SIGMA marked with data-hsc='1') and selects it, 'Terisi:' success message shown, import mode radio hint toggles correctly between Baru and Upgrade, both template downloads produce template_sparepart_baru.csv and template_sparepart_upgrade.csv, and stock page autocomplete for 'OLI' correctly returns OLI-001 suggestion. cURL + XML PHP extensions are working, no more 'Gagal memuat hasil' error.
action_items: Cleanup optional: a test-created part 'TEST-NEW-001' (kategori 'UjiBaru') was inserted in DB during import-baru test. Safe to leave or delete via UI.
Optional: the SIGMA option added dynamically on the parts page will be saved to master categories only if user submits that form (worked as designed).
critical_code_review_comments: parts.php is ~360 lines mixing PHP, HTML and inline JS. Consider splitting the HSC search + import JS into a dedicated asset file for maintainability (not blocking).
lookup_hsc.php uses CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER=false. Acceptable for scraping an external site, but note the security trade-off.
import_parts.php lacks explicit try/catch around beginTransaction; if a PDO exception occurs mid-loop the transaction stays open. Consider wrapping in try/catch with rollBack (minor).
seed_data_creation: Backend test inserted TEST-NEW-001 (kategori 'UjiBaru'). OLI-001 was briefly renamed by upgrade test then restored to prior name.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All bugs described in the review request are fixed and verified. HSC live search now returns results (source='live') with 25+ items for 'shock'. field=auto correctly picks kode vs nama. Import supports mode=baru (skip existing) and mode=upgrade (upsert). Data-testids present on parts + stock pages. Old hscField dropdown element removed completely.
rca of the issue: Original 'Gagal memuat hasil' error was caused by missing php-curl / php-xml extensions preventing lookup_hsc.php from POSTing to hargasukucadang.online. After installing php-curl and php-xml and restarting PHP, the live scraping works (verified: source='live', 25 results for 'shock').
